school: 德国巴洛克作曲家/管风琴家（《平均律键盘曲集》全部24个大小调前奏曲与赋格、《赋格的艺术》、b小调弥撒、马太受难曲、勃兰登堡协奏曲、200余首康塔塔）/教会与宫廷乐师
historical_significance: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫（1685-1750），生于埃森纳赫的音乐世家，是巴洛克音乐的集大成者。1717年因请求离职被魏玛公爵关押近一月，出狱后赴克腾任宫廷乐长；1723年起任莱比锡托马斯教堂乐监直至逝世，每周为礼拜日与节庆创作康塔塔，现存200余首。《平均律键盘曲集》两卷共48首前奏曲与赋格，覆盖全部24个大小调，为十二平均律的实用性立下典范；《赋格的艺术》以单一主题穷尽对位法的一切可能，临终未竟。他一生未离开德国，当时被视为老派的管风琴匠人，1750年逝于莱比锡；79年后门德尔松重演《马太受难曲》，巴赫才被追认为'西方音乐之父'。其音乐把严谨的数学结构（数字象征、可逆卡农、严格的赋格技法）与深沉的宗教情感熔为一体，自署 Soli Deo Gloria（荣耀归于上帝）。
historical_significance_en: Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750), born in Eisenach into a dynasty of musicians, is the summation of Baroque music. Imprisoned for nearly a month by the Duke of Weimar in 1717 for pressing to resign, he then served as Kapellmeister at Cöthen, and from 1723 until his death as Thomaskantor in Leipzig, composing a cantata nearly every week for church and feast days—some 200 survive. The Well-Tempered Clavier's two books of 48 preludes and fugues cover all 24 major and minor keys, establishing the practicality of equal temperament; The Art of Fugue exhausts every possibility of counterpoint from a single theme, left unfinished at his death. He never left Germany and was regarded in his lifetime as an old-fashioned organ craftsman; he died in Leipzig in 1750 and was recognized as the 'father of Western music' only 79 years later, when Mendelssohn revived the St Matthew Passion. His music fuses rigorous mathematical structure—number symbolism, mirror canons, strict fugal technique—with profound religious feeling, signed Soli Deo Gloria.
description_zh: 系统构建者的思维原型：以一条种子主题生成整个作品世界，用严格的约束（赋格、卡农、调性体系）作为生成的引擎而非枷锁，穷举参数空间以建立完备体系，在一周一周的岗位劳作中把工匠纪律与数学秩序统一为深情。
description_en: The prototype of the system builder: grow an entire work-world from a single seed subject, treat strict constraint—fugue, canon, tonal system—as an engine of generation rather than a shackle, exhaust the parameter space to build complete systems, and unify craft discipline with mathematical order into deep feeling through week-by-week labor at a post.
key_concepts: Soli Deo Gloria 工匠伦理
